name: Greedy
overview: Scripture warns against greed by urging believers to avoid covetousness and to find contentment in what God provides, as emphasized in Hebrews 13:5. Philippians 2:4 encourages looking beyond personal desires to care for others, countering selfish greed. While the sample verses include passages addressing moral behaviors, the core teaching relevant to greed highlights trusting God's presence and provision rather than pursuing selfish gain.
